description: A hand-drawn arrow pointing at something in the frame, drawn as if by pen. Give it a target region; the tail is placed automatically unless you set one.

fields.name: rect
fields.label: Target
fields.description: The region the arrow points at, in 0..1 frame coordinates.

fields.name: rect2
fields.label: Tail (optional)
fields.description: Where the arrow starts. Leave at the default for an automatic tail.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Optional short word written beside the tail.

fields.name: colour
fields.label: Ink colour
fields.description: Ink colour of the arrow, as #RRGGBB.
